title: Grilled Mirin-Hon Tendon with Mugi and Shiitake
description: A bold, spring-inspired dish from Shikoku, Japan, featuring mirin-hon and Binchotan-grilled goodness. Mirin-hon adds a rich, umami flavor to this adventurous tendon recipe.
instructions: Soak the mugi in water for at least 4 hours. Drain and rinse before use.
Rinse the tendon noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Heat the sesame oil in a Binchotan grill at 400°F (200°C).
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes on each side or until caramelized.
Add the grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mirin-hon, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked tendon noodles and mugi to the grill. Toss to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
Transfer the noodles and mushrooms to a serving platter.
Sprinkle with thinly sliced green onion and serve hot.
